content.text: KAWASANA OPU o Raja! Taroakamo alamu akaunde-unde;
taroakamo o pulo-pulo mobhari sumai akaunde-unde!
Taʼina ngalu tee kalalanda abulilingi KAWASANA OPU,
kabanara tee kaʼadili amembali polandakana kauncuramakana.
Waa arore i aroana,
apekangau manga bhali i saripina.
Manga bhibhitona asuluwi alamu,
tee o dunia akamatamea tee arengku.
Manga gunu arere mboomo taru i aroana KAWASANA OPU,
i aroana Aulataʼalana saangua alamu.
Laiana apakoleleaka kabanarana,
tee bhari-bharia lipu akamata kamuliangina.
Bhari-bharia mia mosombana barahala bheatopekaea,
siitumo manga incia mosomboakana karona roonamo barahalana;
bhari-bharia dewa bheasuju tee asomba i aroana Kawasana Opu.
Raʼeatina Sion akaunde-unde tee manga kampo modhaangiana i Tana Yuda uka amasanaa,
wakutuuna arango kambotumu, e KAWASANA OPU.
Ingkoomo, e KAWASANA OPU, Momalangana i bhawona saangua alamu;
Ingkoo utomuliangi mpuu alabhi minaaka i bhari-bharia dewa.
E ingkomiu momaasiakana KAWASANA OPU, bancimea o kadhaki!
Sababuna KAWASANA OPU ajagani dhadhina uumatina mosaalihi,
tee arambasakea manga incia minaaka i limana mia madhaki.
Kainawa asuluwi mia mobanara,
tee o kasanaa to mia momakatena incana.
E manga mia mobanara, kaunde-undemo roonamo KAWASANA OPU,
tee usukurumo to sarona momangkilo.
